cards.descriptionZh: 在你的回合开始时，将{Cards:diff()}张随机无色牌添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中。

cards.name: SpoilsOfBattle
cards.title: Spoils of Battle
cards.description:
[gold]Forge[/gold] {Forge:diff()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
cards.descriptionZh:

抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

cards.name: Stardust
cards.title: Stardust
cards.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy X times.
cards.descriptionZh: 随机对敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害X次。

cards.name: SummonForth
cards.title: Summon Forth
cards.description:
Put [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] from anywhere.
[gold]Forge[/gold] {Forge:diff()}.
cards.descriptionZh:
不论何处，将[gold]君王之剑[/gold]放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。
[gold]铸造[/gold]{Forge:diff()}。

cards.name: Supermassive
cards.title: Supermassive
cards.description: Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card you created this combat.
cards.descriptionZh: 造成 {CalculationBase:diff()} 点伤害。本场战斗中每生成一张卡,此牌额外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 点伤害。
dynamicVars: new CalculatedDamageVar(ValueProp.Move).WithMultiplier((CardModel card, Creature? _) => CombatManager.Instance.History.Entries.OfType<CardGeneratedEntry>().Count((CardGeneratedEntry c) => c.Creator == card.Owner))

cards.descriptionZh: [gold]君王之剑[/gold]获得[gold]重放[/gold]{SwordSagePower:diff()}。
